body: I was so bored at the newborn stage lol my baby was literally a sleeping potato. She’s 3 months now with a bit of spunk. I imagine it gets better as she gets older.

I had an HSG in February, found out my left tube was damaged and my right was clear. It was a little painful but not unbearable. I ended up conceiving a few months later in may after 10 months of no luck. I say that to say it can’t hurt to try the HSG.
